id: title:haacked:lower the flag evaluations last called at sync buffer to 360s

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces risk of missing or incomplete flag evaluation data during ClickHouse replica lag by tightening the buffer window and adding a test to prevent reliance on stale-replica fallbacks.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F4.H1 explicitly changes the default value of FEATURE_FLAG_LAST_CALLED_AT_SYNC_FLAG_EVALUATIONS_BUFFER_SECONDS from 900 to 360, while P1.F2.H1 and P1.F3.H1 provide documentation and tests. This configuration adjustment, combined with the test asserting that stale-replica fallback is disabled, demonstrates a substantive, bounded improvement in the reliability of flag-eu

observations.behavior: Documentation and configuration change: P1.F1.H1. The hunk P1.F1.H1 in posthog/settings/feature_flags.py changes the default value of FEATURE_FLAG_LAST_CALLED_AT_SYNC_FLAG_EVALUATIONS_BUFFER_SECONDS from 900 to 360 and updates comments. The comment explains that this buffer must stay above the ClickHouse replica lag limit (300 seconds) to avoid missing rows. The hunk P1.F2.H1 in P1
